points.name: health.activity.explain.section_title
points.interpretation: The common section builder sets the title from its record at offset 8; the page invokes the builder for step, calorie, intensity and standing explanations.

points.name: health.activity.explain.section_body
points.interpretation: The common section builder sets the body from its record at offset 16; the same call serves all four sections.

evidence: The activity manifest registers the explanation descriptor. Its create callback stores the root, prepares translated step, calorie, intensity and standing title/body records and calls the same section builder four times. The builder sets a title and body from record offsets 8 and 16. Destroy clears the root after removing its children.
scope: Only the two shared label calls from the four section-builder invocations while this page root is active. Other pages and the header are outside this scope.
limitations: All sections share each call site; blindly replacing text affects every section. Root slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
